info.name: *-1a_dailytech-api_ENDPOINTS
info.description: Current DailyTech controller routes and role requirements. Select Dailytech_ENV. Run Authentication for separate USER and ADMIN tokens, or supply Firebase ID tokens in the matching token variables. runWrites defaults false; write examples require disposable IDs and manual resource ordering. Previous examples are preserved in a non-executing reference folder. See ../functional-testing/readme.md for the security matrix and test commands. Raw-key routes are now retired and denied for every role. News requests return data via /api/news; see ../README_PROVIDER_SECURITY.md.
